title: Thickthorn Junction Upgrade Progresses
summary: A purpose-built bridge is being craned into place for the £153M Thickthorn junction upgrade on the A47/A11.

title: Black Country Councils Award Highways Framework
summary: Wolverhampton City Council has awarded a new highways works framework valued at £150 million on behalf of Black Country Transport.

title: A38(M) Tame Valley Viaduct Strengthening Completed
summary: The A38(M) Tame Valley Viaduct Strengthening Scheme in north Birmingham has been successfully completed with project management by Arcadis.

title: Tata and Nexperia Form Joint Venture
summary: Nexperia has partnered with Tata Electronics to fabricate and package integrated circuits in India.

title: Huawei Launches Ten AI Chipsets
summary: Huawei has unveiled ten new AI chipsets, including AI accelerators, CPUs, and networking chips.

title: Imec Launches Advanced Hyperspectral Sensor
summary: Imec's advanced hyperspectral sensor for Earth observation and industrial applications has transitioned to broader commercial adoption.

title: Mojave UAS Achieves Battlefield STOL Milestone
summary: General Atomics successfully performed the first short take-off and landing of its Mojave unmanned aircraft on a simulated battlefield.

title: Converting Martian Atmosphere Into Rocket Propellant
summary: A researcher is developing technology to convert the atmosphere of Mars into propellant to fuel the return journey for astronauts.

title: Belfast Harbour Transforms Reclaimed Land Into Deep-Water Berth
summary: Belfast Harbour's £90M D3 development is converting reclaimed land into a new deep-water quay for cruise ships and offshore wind.

title: Direct Visualization of Defect Effects in BaTiO3 Junctions
summary: Researchers combined microscopy and in-situ biasing to establish an asymmetric interfacial pinning mechanism in ferroelectric tunnel junctions.

title: U.S. Awards $1B for Quantum Wafer Manufacturing
summary: The U.S. awarded IBM's Anderon $1 billion to forge quantum wafers domestically.

title: Startup Develops Wafer-Scale Superconducting Transistors
summary: Startup S-Transistors is fabricating superconducting transistors on silicon wafers to eliminate control cables in quantum computers.

title: Ysmart London Introduces Toolt Multitool on Kickstarter
summary: Ysmart London has launched its new key-fob-sized multitool, packing 36 tools into a single module on Kickstarter.

title: NSF Launches Semiconductor Translation Initiative
summary: The U.S. National Science Foundation announced an initiative to translate low-dimensional semiconductor technologies into platforms for advanced microelectronics.

title: First Solar Alters Patent Enforcement Strategy
summary: First Solar is withdrawing its Section 337 complaint while continuing other ongoing lawsuits against solar manufacturers.

title: Designing Long-Travel Axes: Rack and Pinion vs Ball Screws
summary: Rack-and-pinion systems offer speed, precision, and scalability when long-travel motion exceeds the limits of ball screws and linear motors.

title: SafeHarness Improves Coding Agent Safety in Robot Manipulation
summary: Researchers presented SafeHarness, an obstacle-aware harness that helps coding agents prioritize safety and avoid collisions during robot manipulation.

title: Workspace Models Offer Lightweight Robotic Memory
summary: A new workspace token representation uses train-time VLM supervision to provide lightweight latent memory for robotic manipulation tasks without in-the-loop VLM queries.

title: FAMOS Models 3D Articulation from Sparse Observations
summary: FAMOS is a feed-forward model that predicts movable-part segmentation and joint parameters from sparse, unordered sets of partial point clouds.

title: StageGuard Improves Long-Horizon Robot Task Transitions
summary: StageGuard combines teacher-model reasoning and distillation for accurate subtask completion and policy switching in hierarchical robot control.

title: GeoAAC Introduces Geometry-Based Adaptive Action Chunking
summary: GeoAAC dynamically adjusts action horizons in vision-language-action policies based on the reliability of denoising trajectories.

title: Volkswagen Debuts ID.3 GTI Electric Hot Hatch
summary: Volkswagen revealed the ID.3 GTI, featuring 326 horsepower as its most powerful performance badge in an electric vehicle.

title: Agile-WAM Enables Contact-Rich Robot Control
summary: Agile-WAM encodes visual and tactile observations into a shared latent space for high-frequency, contact-rich robot manipulation.

title: OPTED Enhances End-to-End Autonomous Driving via On-Policy Fine-Tuning
summary: OPTED decouples reinforcement learning with a privileged teacher to safely fine-tune end-to-end driving policies in simulation.

title: LLM-Falsifier Evaluates Cyber-Physical Systems via Optimization
summary: LLM-Falsifier uses large language models to find counterexamples in cyber-physical systems by minimizing STL robustness degrees.

title: MILER Enables Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Autonomous Driving
summary: MILER uses a semantic mid-level representation and trajectory-alignment strategy for zero-shot sim-to-real reinforcement learning in autonomous driving.

title: Hydropower Industry Warns of Relicensing Bottlenecks
summary: Over 12 GW of hydropower facing relicensing over the next decade confronts rising regulatory requirements that could threaten generation.

title: New Framework Improves Underwater Visual Target Tracking
summary: A stereo visual-servoing framework combines target-specific depth estimation with adaptive model-fusion predictive control for autonomous underwater vehicles.

title: MoWAM Predicts Future Motion for Efficient World Action Models
summary: MoWAM replaces future video generation with explicit future motion prediction to improve robot policy learning and efficiency.

title: US Power Grid Faces Winter Reliability Challenges
summary: Recent winter storms tested the US power grid, exposing fuel and supply chain strains that will intensify with rising demand.
